proof.text: Construct the generator map from the free sheaf on U(V) to the inverse image of the free sheaf on V using the unit, free abelian lift, and sheafification. Apply the exact functor to Ext classes and precompose with this generator map. Preservation of Yoneda products and extension classes proves naturality and boundary compatibility; naturality of the unit gives degree-zero normalization.
